result.edit: The failure occurs at cycle 11 when the module is in state sf6 and outputs 01 (match=0, not_match=1) when it should output 00. The issue is in the sf6 state transition logic where it incorrectly transitions to sf1 or s1 based on data input. According to the specification, after completing a group (6 bits), the module should reset to idle state to begin checking the next group. Changing the sf6 transition to always go to idle fixes this by properly resetting the state machine after each group is processed.
